mentions.name: Argon Chess
mentions.description: Argon Chess is a deterministic chess variant designed with some degree of cheat resistance and lots of variety, making it hard for chess engines like Fairy Stockfish to play. It supports playing friends online via a Discord Activity, includes a simple 'play a dumb AI' feature on its website, and offers free printable cards for offline play.
mentions.problem: Cheat resistance: the variant is designed so chess engines have difficulty playing it, addressing engine-assisted cheating.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Argon Chess, a deterministic chess variant with some degree of cheat resistance (hard to describe to chess engines like Fairy Stockfish) and tons of variety. A week ago, I added a way to play friends online a week ago (a Discord Activity) and a simple Play a Dumb AI feature on its website. You can also print the cards for free for offline play.
